en: As far as the waters cover all the seas
So high, so great is the love
As far as the east is from the west
You've turned my shame into joyful praise

ko: 영원히 감사 드리리 주님의 그 은혜
날 찾아주신 그 사랑 오 주님 내 전부
en: Forever I will thank You for the grace
I once was lost, but now I'm found,

ko: 사랑해요 경배해요 나 주 위해 살리
en: I worship You, I live for You, You're all that I desire
And forever I will live to tell of Your unfailing love
God so loved the world that He gave His only Son
That whoever believes in Him should never die but have eternal life
In the risen Son of God
